# Track 1: Computer Science Bachelor Track

This track is intended for students who enter the RSE Master with a **Bachelor in Computer
Science**. Because the computer-science foundations are already covered by the entry degree, the
corresponding modules carry **0 ECTS** here; the freed-up capacity is invested into elective
computer-science depth, software engineering, a domain specialization, and the RSE-specific
competencies.

The curriculum follows the six competency areas (*Bereiche*) of Table 5.1 of the curricular
recommendations. The table below reproduces that structure — including its colour coding — with the
ECTS that apply to Track 1.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

*A value of 0 ECTS means the competency is already provided by the Computer Science entry Bachelor
and is listed only for completeness.*

**\*\*** Recommended for Track 1 students interested in natural-science RSE as an alternative to the
elective Software Engineering courses.

**\*\*\*** Recommended courses for the elective area, subject to availability (see alternatives in
the text). The specific computer-science electives are listed on the
[Computer Science Elective](../modules/cs_elective.qmd) page.
